voiceTapTitle: Recording: say it, then tap Next step
voiceBlocked: The microphone could not be used. Allow the microphone for this page, or add an audio file instead.
voiceUnsupported: This browser cannot record from the microphone. Add an audio file instead.
voiceReadFailed: That audio could not be read. Try an MP3, M4A or WAV file.
voiceFit: Spread the steps to fit the voice
voiceNoSound: This browser cannot put sound into the video. The video will be made without it. You can add your voice in your editing app.
fourKHint: 4K needs a recent computer or phone and takes the longest. The file is large.
keepOpenSmooth: Drawing every frame: {done}% done, about {left} seconds left. Keep this screen on and stay on this page.
keepOpen: Keep this screen on and stay on this page while the video records. It takes as long as the video.
smoothNote: Saved as an MP4 file with every frame drawn, at 30 frames a second.
webmNote: This browser saves WebM video. It plays in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. If an app does not accept it, open this page in Chrome on a computer or a recent Android phone and save again.
noRecord: This browser cannot record video. You can still preview and save a picture. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox to make the video.
failed: The video could not be made. Try 720p or fewer steps, and keep this page open while it records.
voiceHint: Record your voice while you tap through the slides, so each photo changes when you say it. Or add an audio file you already have. Your voice stays on your device.
voiceReady: Tap Next step each time you move to the next photo. The video starts on your first tap.
voiceTimed: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. The photos change at the moments you tapped.
voiceFitted: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. The photos are spread to fit it.
voiceChanged: Voice added: {name}, {seconds} seconds. You changed the photos after recording, so they are spread to fit the voice.
tip: Tip: save the video, then drop it into Instagram Edits, CapCut or InShot. If you added your voice here, the sound is already in the file.
credit: Photos are shrunk to 1280 pixels on the long side while you work, which is plenty for a phone video.
empty: Add your photos, or tap Use sample pictures to see how it looks.
startersHint: A starter sets the title, end card, look and captions style. Add your photos, then tap Fill empty captions to start from its suggested captions.
photosHint: Add up to {max} photos. The first photo is slide 1. Use Up and Down to change the order.
tooMany: Only {max} photos are used. The extra ones were left out.
photoFailed: {name} could not be read. Try a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
caption: Caption for photo {n}
cardsHint: Leave the title or the end card empty to skip it. The title also names the saved file.

fillHint.fill: The photo fills the screen and the edges are cropped. Best for photos taken for a Reel.
fillHint.fit: Shows the whole photo with a soft blurred copy behind it. Best when you do not want anything cut off.
fillHint.polaroid: Each photo sits in a white print frame, slightly tilted, on the colour of your look. The caption is written under the photo.

motionHint: Automatic changes the move from photo to photo. You can change one photo in its own box above.
notSaved: Your photos are not saved between visits, only your settings and words. Make the video before you leave the page.
